units.source_text: 仓库大概有十二张榻榻米那么大。

en.t: The storehouse was about the size of twelve tatami mats.

units.source_text: 本来还算宽敞，但如今放了衣柜、长形火炉、收纳柜、置物架等诸多家具，就显得有些狭小了。

en.t: It had once been fairly spacious, but now that it held wardrobes, a long brazier, storage cabinets, shelves, and many other pieces of furniture, it felt somewhat cramped.

units.source_text: 这所有的家当里边，最突出的就是三十几个桐木箱子。

en.t: Among all these household things, the most conspicuous were more than thirty paulownia boxes.

units.source_text: 倘若我不说是为什么，你估计也猜不到。

en.t: If I did not tell you why, you probably would never guess.

units.source_text: 箱子里装着的就是雏人偶。

en.t: What was packed inside the boxes was a set of hina dolls.

units.source_text: 为了方便随时搬走，因此一直堆在靠窗的墙壁附近。

en.t: So that they could be carried away at any time, they had been kept piled near the wall by the window.

units.source_text: 因为无尽灯被拿去店里使用，所以仓库里只点着朦胧的纸灯笼。

en.t: Because the oil lamp had been taken to be used in the shop, only a dim paper lantern was lit in the storehouse.

units.source_text: 在朦胧的灯光下，母亲正在缝制药袋，哥哥坐在又旧又小的书桌前读英文书。

en.t: In the dim light, Mother was sewing medicine pouches, and my elder brother sat at an old, small desk reading an English book.

units.source_text: 一切和平常没什么两样。

en.t: Everything was just as it usually was.

units.source_text: 不过，我不经意间看了母亲一眼，母亲的手上虽然做着针线活，但是低垂眼睑的睫毛里面已经盈满泪水。

en.t: But when I happened to glance at Mother, though her hands were still doing needlework, tears had already filled the lashes of her lowered eyelids.
